question: Which of the following associations has launched a coalition named ‘United for Biodiversity’ on World Wildlife Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**European Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **European Commission** has launched a coalition named **‘United for Biodiversity**’ on **World Wildlife Day 2020.**
 
• The coalition is made up of **zoos, Botanical gardens, National parks, Science museums and Natural history** from around the world **to provide opportunities for them to join forces and boost public awareness about the nature crisis.**
 
• These organizations not only **preserve natural resources but are centres for education and mobilization.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Wildlife Day** is celebrated every year on the **3rd of March**.

 
 
• Theme 2020 - **Sustaining all life on Earth.**
 
 
 
• **European Commission**__ -
 
 
• **Established- in 1958.**
 
• **Headquarters- Brussels, Belgium.**
 
• **President - Ursula von der Leyen.**
 
• **Croatia **is the newest member country.
